title: Sharing a whole library
intro: Share a whole library when several people need lasting access to everything in it, including files added later. You can share libraries you own or manage.

sections.heading: Open a library's Share window
text: Open the library switcher at the top of the left rail.
steps: Click the **Share** icon next to a library you own.
sections.tip: For the library you are in, you can also click **Share “Client Projects”…** at the bottom of the list.
sections.note: A library you do not manage shows **Your access to “Finance”…** instead. It tells you how you can get in, but does not let you change anything.

sections.heading: Share it with a person or a group
steps: Click **Share to user** to add a person, or **Share to group** to add a whole team.
Type an email address and press Enter, or choose a group from the list.
bullets: **Read-Write** lets someone add, change and delete files, and create links to send things to people outside Acme.
**Read-only** lets someone open and download files, but not change anything.
To change someone's level, choose a new one from the dropdown next to their name. Click **Remove** to take away their access.
sections.note: Neither level lets someone add other people. Only you or your administrator can do that. Files someone added before you shared the library stay private to them.

sections.heading: See everyone who has access
text: Click **Who has access** at the top of the window. It lists everyone who can open the library, however they got in, including through a group.
steps: Click a person's name to see how they can get in.
bullets: Links to files or folders in this library show here too, under **Anyone with a link**, each with its own **Revoke** button.
People who have not signed in to Depot yet show under **Waiting**. They get in once they sign in with that email address.

sections.heading: Create a library of your own
steps: Open the library switcher and click **＋ New library** at the bottom of the list.
Type a name for the library.
sections.note: A new library is private until you share it. Only you and your administrator can see it.
